profile.name: Vanshaj Raghuvanshi
profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI Systems, Agentic Workflows, and Cloud/Backend Infrastructure
profile.bio: Software engineer focused on Generative AI and agentic systems, with hands on experience across AI infrastructure, backend and cloud. Builds AI agents, tool calling pipelines and RAG systems, instruments them with provider agnostic observability, and ships the distributed backends behind them, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, and production-ready design. Computer Science and Engineering graduate, previously at DXFactor and DRDO.
profile.about: Hi, I'm **Vanshaj Raghuvanshi**, a **software engineer** working on Generative AI and **agentic systems**. I build AI agents, tool calling pipelines and RAG systems, along with the infrastructure they run on: **provider agnostic observability, distributed backends, and secure data access**, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and production-ready design. Most recently I worked on **AI agents and infrastructure** at DXFactor, and on AI research and development at DRDO.

alts: Engineered a multi-tenant RAG system with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enabling secure querying over **5,000+ documents**.

highlights.text: Created POCs using OpenResponses, MCP tools, and agent frameworks to evaluate provider interoperability, tool-calling behavior, and enterprise AI workflows.
alts: Developed POCs on a provider-agnostic, distributed AI platform using agent frameworks (OpenResponses, MCP tools) with product and engineering teams to ensure client alignment and feasibility.

projects.name: EV Digital Twin Platform
projects.summary: A production grade platform that keeps a physical electric vehicle fleet in sync with its digital replicas in real time, combining physics based battery and thermal simulation, normalised telemetry ingestion from 601 vehicles, ML powered battery health prediction and an interactive fleet dashboard.

highlights.text: Developed a multi-service digital twin platform processing telemetry from **601 vehicles** for battery health monitoring and analytics.
Implemented a Bidirectional LSTM utilizing **60–80+ telemetry features** to predict battery degradation with **±2% prediction error**.
Designed streaming APIs and analytics pipelines delivering battery insights with **100–500ms latency**.
Integrated physics-based battery simulations with machine learning models for degradation forecasting and scenario analysis.

projects.name: LLM Insight Engine
projects.summary: A provider agnostic observability engine for generative AI applications. Rather than coupling a backend to one vendor's SDK wrappers, it emits pure OpenTelemetry spans using the standard GenAI semantic conventions and streams them to Langfuse over OTLP/HTTP, leaving the model adapters free of any tracing logic.

highlights.text: Developed a provider-agnostic observability middleware supporting **2 inference providers** across cloud and local deployments.
Captured and exported **5 telemetry dimensions** using OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, adapter-based instrumentation, and OTLP exports for unified tracing across heterogeneous LLM providers.
alts: Captured and exported **5 telemetry dimensions** (latency, token usage, prompts, responses, tool calls) using OpenTelemetry and Langfuse.

highlights.text: Implemented adapter-based instrumentation and OTLP exports enabling unified tracing across heterogeneous LLM providers.

projects.name: Axiom
projects.summary: The assistant on this site: a server-side agent that answers from the same validated data the site is built from, through tools exposed as a public MCP server. It acts on the page (scrolls to sections, opens the resume, drafts an email for the visitor to send) and routes each request across Groq and Gemini models with automatic fallback.

highlights.text: Passed **26/26** cases on an eval set covering tool choice, page actions, grounded facts and prompt-injection refusals, at **2.9 s median** and **5.4 s p95** latency.
Built a provider-agnostic router that discovers models at runtime, ranks them by family and benches failing ones, recovering every request that needed a fallback in evaluation.
Exposed career-data lookups as an MCP server that the agent calls in-process and any MCP client can use over streamable HTTP.
Replaced keyword intent detection with model tool calls that drive the page, validating server-side that a drafted email is grounded in the visitor's own words.
Instrumented every request with OpenTelemetry GenAI spans plus live latency and fallback stats.

projects.name: MCP + OpenResponses Agent
projects.summary: A provider agnostic AI agent that pairs the Model Context Protocol with the OpenAI Responses API spec, so tools are defined once through MCP and become callable by models from any provider, with automatic multi tool chaining, a Streamlit interface and a Dockerised runtime.

highlights.text: Built a provider-agnostic multi-turn agent runtime supporting **2 LLM providers**, **3 MCP tools**, and workflows spanning up to **8 reasoning iterations**.
Implemented a custom orchestration loop and asynchronous MCP server enabling context reconstruction, tool chaining, and standardized execution of weather, geocoding, and timezone services.
Implemented a custom orchestration loop handling context reconstruction, tool chaining, and iterative reasoning without external agent frameworks.
Architected an asynchronous MCP server exposing weather, geocoding, and timezone services through stdio-based IPC and standardized tool execution interfaces.

projects.name: depthpad
projects.summary: Turns a Hall-effect keyboard into an analog game controller: how far you press a key becomes how far the stick moves or the trigger pulls, through a virtual Xbox 360 or DualShock 4 controller that works in any game with controller support.

highlights.text: Built a Rust and Tauri Windows app that converts Hall-effect key depth into analog stick and trigger travel through a virtual Xbox 360 or DualShock 4 controller.
Designed a drag-to-map key binder with a live view of controller output and a response-curve editor offering **7 presets** plus anti-deadzone tuning.
Kept the background engine to about **6 MB of memory** and **1% of one CPU core** while polling key travel over USB.
Integrated analog USB protocols covering **269 keyboards from 95 brands**, with a probe tool that lets users report unsupported boards.
Shipped signed-checksum releases with a driver-bootstrapping installer, portable build and in-app auto-updater, delivering **3 releases** on launch day.
alts: Built the release pipeline (installer that bootstraps the ViGEmBus driver, portable build, SHA-256 checksums, in-app auto-updates).
